Quantum 1.32.0 was certified on 2026-09-12. It pins **nucleus v1.28.0**, **quark v1.14.0** and **orbit v1.9.6**, with 23 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.31.0: nucleus goes from v1.27.0 to v1.28.0 (minor), orbit goes from v1.9.5 to v1.9.6 (patch) and quark stays at v1.14.0. 4 sibling modules change version.
